A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 29 readable pages, including Appendices A–E and the prompt templates. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable matching of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 46 LLMs in Table 1, checker-validation experiments, and prediction, training, and test-time-scaling results, with additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark evaluations and experiments, including the empirical results in Appendices A, D, and E.

M1.justification: The three cousin-prompt augmentation procedures, code-assisted validity checker, prediction methods, fine-tuning procedures, and rejection sampling remain unchanged in Sections 3–5 and Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same IFEVAL/IFEVAL++ constraint and augmentation coverage, pilot scenarios, and Alpaca and cousin-prompt training datasets. No evaluated task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 contains the same 46 evaluated models. Table 2 retains verbalized confidence, perplexity, and probing, while Appendix E.2 retains the same SFT-versus-DPO comparison.

E3.justification: The 541 groups of ten prompts, prompt-strict evaluation, reliable@k metrics, default decoding settings, prediction splits, 312-step training budget, and test-time-scaling settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the checker-validation tests, repeated-sampling comparison, system-prompt sensitivity, reliable@k scalability, larger-model pilot, constraint-category analysis, and training-method analysis. No supplementary analysis is added or revised.

E5.justification: Sampling, run, and seed descriptions and statistical reporting practices are unchanged. v2 introduces no additional uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains GPT-5's 95.9% IFEVAL accuracy and 78.4% reliable@10; appendix results also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The reliable@k definition in Section 2.2 and the SFT objective in Appendix E.1 are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, formal result, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about nuance-oriented reliability, reliable@k, IFEVAL++, existing models' reliability gaps, and the three explored improvement pathways.

C2.justification: The interpretations of model behavior, training effects, and reasoning remain identical. All substantive limitations are retained; the Limitations section is merely renumbered from 7 to 8.

D1.justification: Model deployment details, training hyperparameters, prompt templates, and code/data access information are unchanged. The new institutional-support acknowledgment supplies no additional implementation or hardware configuration.

R1.justification: The cited works, Appendix A's survey of 36 benchmarks, and distinctions from prompt-sensitivity research and pass^k remain unchanged. No research-positioning revision accompanies the acknowledgment.

P1.justification: v2 adds a corresponding-author footnote and Section 7, Acknowledgment, crediting Ant Group and Tsinghua University's Center for High Performance Computing. Limitations and Ethical Considerations are renumbered; the scientific prose is unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page numbers and modestly reflows the main text and references around the additions. All 11 figures and 10 tables retain their displays and captions; appendix layouts otherwise match exactly.

improvement.justification: The corresponding-author note and support acknowledgment improve administrative completeness, but the scientific exposition, evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the appendices. These additions and the accompanying layout adjustments do not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
